Subject: Recap + Steering committee ask (Fintegrate / Redwood)

Hi Laura / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a suggested plan to get the exec steering committee review scheduled so you can make a procurement recommendation before month-end.

Key points from our call:
- Primary use case: real-time summarization and question-answering across customer transaction logs (low-latency inference on sensitive data).
- Scale target: 50k inference calls/day initially, spiking to ~200k during peak windows.
- Decision drivers: latency SLA, unit cost per inference, data isolation / auditability (SOC2 + KMS), and predictable throughput.

Suggested next steps:
1) Exec steering committee (30-45m) to review architecture, cost model, and compliance commitments.
2) Security/Procurement questionnaire + evidence pack (SOC2, retention controls, audit logs).
3) Mutual action plan with milestones and contract timeline.

I've attached a short exec brief (redwood-exec-brief.pdf) and a draft mutual-action-plan.xlsx to use as a pre-read and to seed the plan. Could you confirm who will attend from the Fintegrate side (economic buyer, security, procurement)? Also, what dates work next week for a 30-45m exec review?

Proposed times we have open: Tues 6/16 10am PT, Thurs 6/18 10am PT, Fri 6/19 9am PT. If none of these work, happy to coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-exec-brief.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — this looks right and helpful. Quick mapping from our side so you can target the deck and the MAM appropriately: 

Stakeholders / roles:
- Economic buyer: Tom Barrett (CFO) — primary decision on financial commitment and procurement cadence.
- Exec sponsor: Laura Simmons (VP, Product) — owns product requirements and exec alignment.
- Security/Privacy: Ravi Kumar, SecOps lead (r.kumar@fintegrate.com) — will lead the security questionnaire and evidence review.
- Procurement: procurement@fintegrate.com (managed by our vendor team) — will handle T&Cs and SOW.

Decision criteria:
1) Demonstrable latency/throughput for 95th pctile under target load.
2) Clear data isolation and encryption + KMS integration.
3) Predictable unit cost and a path to committed capacity (Reserved / Dedicated).
4) SLAs and support for canary/fallback behavior.

Timeline: procurement wants to finish vendor evaluation this month if possible — target procurement sign-off the week of 6/29. Steering committee availability: Thurs 6/18 10am PT works best for the execs here.

Please include a 1-page pre-read (exec summary + topline numbers) and a proposed run-of-show so the execs can review ahead of time. Ravi will be the security point of contact; looping him here for any immediate evidence requests.

I'll wait for the invite (6/18 10am PT) and the pre-read.

Best,
Laura
